arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
arcs.summary: Day 4: The Guild archivist, Mabel Forsythe-Crue, has provided a single index card: 'D.H. — Appalachian circuit — leaves them where they'll find them.' She has declined to elaborate. Pemwick has traced 'D.H.' to a footnote in the 1987 appendix listing them as 'Benefactor, Circuit Unknown.' The Bandit has initials and a territory. Day 5 (resolution): The final edition should reveal D.H. fully — a warmly elusive figure, perhaps a longtime traveller of the Appalachian circuit who leaves hatted ducks specifically for people who take care of their trails and their Jeeps, drawn to Christine and Steve by reputation. The resolution should feel earned and affectionate: the Bandit is revealed not as a prankster but as a recogniser of good people, and the ducks are understood as a kind of blessing from someone who knows the ridgelines. Pemwick files his final report. The Jeep may receive one more duck.
